iran: Cruise missiles hit 2 Emirati tankers in Omani waters
tldr: A five-hour precision package struck six sites along Iran's entire southern littoral. Late in the day, UAE authorities said Iranian cruise missiles had struck two Emirati-linked supertankers in Omani waters, killing one crew member and wounding eight.
